<!-- Shared concept: the two ways to write a color. -->
| Write a color as | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| a color name string | `"darkturquoise"` | any name from the [Pygame Zero color list]({{< var pgzero.colors >}}) |
| an RGB tuple | `(150, 0, 100)` | red = 150, green = 0, blue = 100, each from 0 to 255 |
